title: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4-Spark on two Sparks
evidence_scope: MTP3 with native prefix caching, a 1,048,576-token context window and, for the default nvfp4-spark checkpoint, 10 GiB of KV cache per Spark in 2,048-token pages. On installer image dev-20260928-plainstatus-cuda1342-nccl2323-status033, the deployment reported 1,530,566 KV tokens (performance/records/images/dev-20260928-plainstatus-glm53-flash-tp2-20260929.md); image, video and text memory loads on that image are in performance/records/glm53-flash/installer-memory-20260929.md. On installer image dev-20261001-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on one pair passed 7 of 7 functional checks (counting, arithmetic, code, tool calls, image, thinking) and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate response, and decoded 37.7 / 107 / 97 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 2,497 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20261001-kraken-glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp2-20261001.md). On installer image dev-20261004-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on two Sparks of a four-Spark ring passed 7 of 7 functional checks and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate or failed response, and decoded 35.7 / 110 / 99 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 2,403 tokens/s, medians of two runs (performance/records/images/dev-20261004-kraken-glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp2-20261004.md). Timings on earlier images are single runs; not serving-qualified.
